title: Which Demon Slayer breathing style are you? Demon Slayer quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Demon Slayer quiz: answer 12 questions to find your Breathing style (Water, Flame, Thunder, Beast, Insect, Wind, Mist, Love, Sound or Stone) and the Demon Slayer character who shares it. No sign-up.
h1: Which Demon Slayer breathing style are you?
lede: Would you flow like Water, burn like Flame or strike like Thunder? Answer 12 questions about your personality and find the Breathing style, and the slayer, that matches you.
about: In Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba, swordsmen fight with Breathing styles. Water, Flame, Thunder, Wind and Stone are the main styles; others, such as Insect, Mist, Love and Sound, branched off from them, and Inosuke made up Beast Breathing on his own.

Each style suits a certain temperament, so this quiz looks at how you handle pressure, train and care for people. Your result names the style, the character who uses it and your scores for all ten. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Koyoharu Gotouge, Shueisha, Aniplex or ufotable; the names belong to their owners.

faq.q: How many breathing styles are there in Demon Slayer?
faq.a: The story shows more than a dozen. Sun Breathing is the original; Water, Flame, Thunder, Wind and Stone are the main styles, and several others branched off from them.

faq.q: Which breathing style does Tanjiro use?
faq.a: Tanjiro learns Water Breathing, then also uses Hinokami Kagura, the dance his family passed down, which is tied to Sun Breathing.

faq.q: Why isn't Sun Breathing a result?
faq.a: Sun Breathing is the original style and only a few characters ever use it, so the quiz sticks to the styles slayers actually train in.
No. It is a free fan quiz, and your answers stay in your browser.

water.name: Water Breathing · Tanjiro Kamado, Giyu Tomioka
water.body: Kind, adaptable and calm under pressure. You flow around problems instead of smashing through them, and you'll do anything to protect your family.

flame.name: Flame Breathing · Kyojuro Rengoku
flame.body: Warm, brave and wholehearted. You encourage everyone around you, eat with gusto and live up to the people who believed in you. Set your heart ablaze.

thunder.name: Thunder Breathing · Zenitsu Agatsuma
thunder.body: Nervous until the moment it counts, then brilliant. You may doubt yourself out loud, but you have practiced one thing until it's perfect, and it's enough.

beast.name: Beast Breathing · Inosuke Hashibira
beast.body: Wild, competitive and self-taught. You learn by doing, charge straight at every challenge and are more loyal to your friends than you'll ever admit.

insect.name: Insect Breathing · Shinobu Kocho
insect.body: Gentle, clever and sharper than you look. You smile through everything, solve problems with knowledge and care, and keep a quiet fire burning underneath.

wind.name: Wind Breathing · Sanemi Shinazugawa
wind.body: Fierce, blunt and intensely protective. You look rough on the outside, but everything you do is about keeping the people you love safe.

mist.name: Mist Breathing · Muichiro Tokito
mist.body: Calm, gifted and a little dreamy. You pick things up fast, drift off easily and surprise everyone when your focus suddenly sharpens.

love.name: Love Breathing · Mitsuri Kanroji
love.body: Affectionate, open and stronger than you look. You wear your heart on your sleeve, love good food and good company, and your warmth is your power.

sound.name: Sound Breathing · Tengen Uzui
sound.body: Flashy, confident and full of style. You do everything with flair, plan boldly and protect the people closest to you above all else.

stone.name: Stone Breathing · Gyomei Himejima
stone.body: A gentle giant. You are patient, compassionate and unshakable, and your quiet strength is what everyone leans on when things get hard.
